_comment: DATA, not code: a different corpus brings its own vocabulary and
nothing in Application/ or pipeline/ changes -- the same reasoning
Seeded from the types the corpus already uses, so the classifier
agrees with the labels already shown on the knowledge-base page and
attached to citations. Adding a type here is enough; the model is
constrained to this list plus 'Unclassified' and cannot invent one.
Keep the labels as they should APPEAR to a project manager -- they
are rendered verbatim in the KB page and in every citation.
